why: The listed declarations (IsCellAttachment, IsFiniteCellComplexType) are definitions, so A = True and B ⇒ A is trivial. B is cellular approximation for an attaching map into a Mathlib CWComplex, plus 'attaching along a cellular map gives a CW-complex'. Neither is in Mathlib or the project, so B is not proved. This is exactly the step the project replaces: IsFiniteCellComplexType means 'homotopy equivalent to an iterated adjunction space with arbitrary (non-cellular) attaching maps', not 'homotopy equivalent to a finite CW-complex'. The two notions agree only via cellular approximation (B) and Lemmas 3.6/3.7. Neither comparison between the project's notion and Mathlib's CWComplex is provable here without that missing theory.
